Name: Morris to Morissa - Female Morris Gender Swap Portraits and Sprites
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Replaces Morris with Morissa!

Replaces Morris's name, pronouns, portraits, sprites, and the Joja Form signature, too! 

[b]Config:[/b] 
Portrait and sprite glasses can be toggled through config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b]Not Supported:[/b]
❌ Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion, Across the Aisle, A Little More Cutscenes, custom NPC mods, and other Morris portrait, dialogue, or cutscene expansions.

Custom dialogue/NPC mods will still call her Morris, use he/him pronouns, show mismatched artwork, cause missing sprites, or make Morris reappear. 

[b]⚠️Compatibility Requests: [/b]I’m no longer taking requests for additional mod compatibility. I want to focus on pixel art instead, and making other fun mods! I will still maintain the current Morissa compatibilities.

If another mod author would like to create or take over compatibility, you’re welcome to use Morissa’s assets as needed. I just ask that you message me a link to your mod so I can add it to this page and that you credit me and link back to my Nexus profile.
